editorial:
Imagine being stuck in a crowded prison with a demon who can grant any wish you want, but always finds a way to turn it into a nightmare. That is exactly what happens here. You follow Morgana, who accidentally lets the Djinn out during a robbery gone wrong. The Djinn is a total jerk who loves to play mind games, and he decides that a prison is the perfect place to gather more wishes. He manipulates the inmates, turning their deepest hopes into bloody traps. It is a wild ride that feels like a dark fairy tale mixed with a prison movie, giving you a fun, creepy vibe from start to finish.

The special effects are old school, but that actually makes the gore feel more real and punchy. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, although some of the acting is a bit over the top. If you love movies where a villain is smarter than everyone else, you will dig this. It is a great pick for a late-night movie marathon with friends. It is a total blast for horror fans who do not take things too seriously.
endingExplained: In the end, Morgana and a priest try to trick the Djinn using a special mirror. They manage to trap him inside the mirror by using his own rules against him. The Djinn thinks he has won, but he ends up being sucked back into his prison. Everything wraps up with the demon gone, though the movie leaves you wondering if he could ever find a way to break out again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves campy horror and wicked villains.
